name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: Senior Product Designer
tagline: Product direction, interface craft, and an AI-assisted build practice.
intro: What holds my attention is interaction design: how a thing responds, what it does while it waits, and how it recovers. I build to find out: a prototype in code answers questions a static frame cannot.
metaDescription: Product designer. I build what I design.
heroClaim:
I design AI and
fintech products
people can trust.
Then I build them.
workedWith: Worked with InstaDeep (BioNTech), Konnect, Steer AI and Groupado

values.heading: How I work
values.body: I learned most of this from watching handoffs go wrong. A design that stops at the handoff gets built as something else, and a component that only works when I’m in the room to explain it isn’t finished. So I stay next to the build, and I’d rather hear what’s wrong at the prototype than at launch.

aboutIntro.heading:
I design products where the interface
has to carry trust.
paragraphs: AI, blockchain and fintech all ask someone to act on a system they cannot check for themselves. Six years of my work has been in that gap.
Day to day that means interaction: how a product responds, what it does while it waits, how it recovers. I map the system before I draw a screen, then prototype in code to check how it feels.
